retainedSourceReasons.data/sloupek_vrata.pac: Batch31: opaque 32x256 photographed aged green gatepost, with baked cylindrical shading and nonuniform worn coating/substrate. The six variants share full-height post faces and cap/bevel reductions across four LODs; finite UVs and material/light mode0 do not establish uniform dielectric optics. Central UV bounds isolate no complete original triangle. Preserve the Batch03 mixed-paint/metal fallback, original ClampU and repeating/overshooting V; no alias, coating mask, normal repair or inferred conductor response.
retainedSourceReasons.data/zlenej_blivajz.pac: Batch31: opaque 8x64 dark green striped/mottled hardware source on narrow gate braces/frame details. Repeating V spans approximately -1.076 to6.020; even unit-square bounds select no complete original triangle. Color and opacity do not identify a uniform paint layer, metal substrate or independent ambient. Preserve original repetition and the Batch03 retained optical contract; no whole-source dielectric adoption or speculative UV wrapping mask.
retainedSourceReasons.data/blck_sum.pac: Batch31: opaque 32x32 black utility fill on tiny upper/lower post caps, not source-declared paint, metal or recovered albedo. All60 source-unknown cap triangles retain authored cap normals/shading. The caps do not establish the mixed painted-post optics. Shared building/sign/quay users remain independently scoped; no global black-source identity.
retainedSourceReasons.o/misc/dd_rust_tile03.pac: Batch31: opaque 128x256 photograph of dark green peeling coating and pale exposed/weathered substrate, not a homogeneous rust dielectric. Full-height narrow cylindrical post faces span the mixture, with U repetition; upper-strip/interior patch bounds isolate no complete ordinary original face triangles. Original lower-LOD post normals in dd_pletivo and dd_pletivo_dira are invalid (24 geometry exclusions), not repaired. Retain original coating/substrate shading; the separate wire alpha source and damaged opening stay gated. All three original source users are reviewed, without extending PBR/GI to uncertain metal/coating optics.
retainedSourceReasons.o/hous/vlnityplot02.pac: Batch31: opaque 512x512 photographed weathered corrugated sheet with grime/oxidation, seams/fasteners and baked corrugation shading. Lower-half UV bounds contain all12 broad ordinary panel triangles per model across three LODs; upper-half bounds select only eight small support triangles. Both halves remain mixed sheet/coating/weathering imagery, not mineral cladding or independent albedo; a central clean-patch bound selects no complete triangle. 96 other textured triangles retain authored material207 lighting, and16 untextured triangles retain render-behavior exclusion. Preserve original faces, corrugation artwork, ClampU|ClampV and lighting; no guessed galvanized-metal/coating response or GI receiver. Shared domek_rosa/hangar_2 users are recorded, not globally reclassified.
